scope: Primary-source context; our sparse guarded nudge optimizer does not satisfy a smooth global-gradient convergence theorem by assumption. No global-optimality guarantee inferred.

sources.claim: Adaptive step-size convergence guarantees in this paper rely on convexity and smoothness assumptions.
General nonconvex analysis targets second-order stationarity; global convergence is established for specific structured examples.
Momentum benefits depend on optimization regime; larger effective steps can explain the gains under the stated assumptions.
